title: Dreams
text: No, Mom, I know. I'm glad everyone's home safe. I just miss things the way they used to be, you know? It's like the city's right outside my window, but... I know. I know. Okay, well, I love you, too. Bye. Oh, no, you don't want this. This is dream pizza. Okay.
